description: This file declares functions for handling 'sheens' device requests within the Zilker SDK, including parsing device IDs, creating device URIs, and generating JSON objects for device and timer actions.

methods.name: sheens_parse_device_id
methods.description: Parses a device ID string into uuid and endpoint components.

methods.name: sheens_get_device_uri
methods.description: Constructs a device URI path given source string and resource.

methods.name: sheens_create_write_device_request
methods.description: Creates a JSON object representing a request to write to a device resource.

methods.name: sheens_create_timer_fired_object
methods.description: Creates a JSON object indicating a timer has fired, identified by UUID.

methods.name: sheens_create_timer_emit_object
methods.description: Creates a JSON object to set up a timer with specified seconds, UUID, and message.

methods.name: sheens_create_timer_oneshot_request
methods.description: Creates a JSON object to set up a one-shot timer with specified duration and JavaScript action.
